name: Cranium Rat
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 20, Cranium Rat Traits. See p. 6 for Tiny creatures.
sourceRevision: Mirrored full text of the published sequel
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The traits allow Common speech and expressly grant finesse to the bite. Treat Pinch as one individual, without swarm abilities. Apply the supplement's quarter carrying capacity.

name: Darkling
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 21, Darkling Traits. p. 86, Darkling Elder racial feat.
sourceRevision: Mirrored full text of the published sequel
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The feat calls the p. 21 Death Flash 'Death Burst' and supplies dice without a damage type. Read the names as the same trait. Nim uses the base profile, so the feat's damage type needs no ruling here.

name: Devourer
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceRevision: Mirrored full text of the published sequel
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: Use the player conversion of the fiend. The soul-rending wave covers each living intelligent creature in range and the trait grants no exception for allies. Use the ordinary Hit Die recovery amount for the alternative recovery.

name: Draegloth
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceRevision: Mirrored full text of the published sequel
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The player trait permits four item-holding hands while preserving the normal attack count, qualifying weapon requirement, and shield trade-offs. Ril uses the Two-Weapon Fighting style to add Strength to the bonus attack.

name: Firenewt
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceRevision: Mirrored full text of the published sequel
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The printed Spite Fire text gives its Constitution-based DC but omits the target's save ability and damage type. Sere uses Dexterity and fire as explicit table rulings. Playing a Firenewt mentions Imix's Blessing, but the mirrored feat section contains no entry under that title.
